ns2:section.sectionText: You must attend one of the mandatory online orientations for this class. The mandatory online orientation will take place on Monday, October 17th through the course Compass site. Orientations will be held at 4:30, 5:00, 5:30, 6:00, and 6:30. You may choose to attend any of the 30 minute sessions. The course content and instruction will be delivered using the Compass course management system. There will NOT be a required meeting time but there will be weekly online discussions, lessons, and assignments. All specifics will be outlined on Compass. Behavioral Sciences course. Topic: Children, Language and Communication Ability. SECOND EIGHT WEEK CLASS. The Department does not wait list.
